description: This file implements DNS SRV record lookup functions for service discovery within the etcd project, including cluster and client endpoint resolution.

methods.name: GetCluster
methods.description: Resolves DNS SRV records to discover cluster nodes and their URLs.

methods.name: GetClient
methods.description: Resolves DNS SRV records to discover client endpoints for a service.

methods.name: GetSRVService
methods.description: Generates an SRV service name with optional suffix based on scheme and service name.
